item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00201","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C13","C09","C20"],"selected_candidate_label":"C13","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C13 is the immediately preceding annual Cancer Control Month proclamation and supplies both the child’s operative structure and extensive near-verbatim language. Both cite the same joint resolution, set apart April as Cancer Control Month, invite governors to issue similar proclamations, and call upon the same professions, media, organizations, and individuals to unite in a national cancer-control effort. The updated year and revised factual recitals do not diminish this clear drafting-template relationship. C09 and C20 have weaker parallels as public-mobilization proclamations but lack the child’s distinctive language and machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas by a joint resolution approved March 28, 1938 (52 Stat. 148), the Congress authorized and requested the President to issue annually a proclamation setting apart the month of April as Cancer Control Month","parent_excerpt":"Whereas by a joint resolution approved March 28, 1938 (52 Stat. 148), the Congress authorized and requested the President to issue annually a proclamation setting apart the month of April as Cancer Control Month","explanation":"This distinctive statutory recital is reproduced verbatim."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby set apart the month of April 1949 as Cancer Control Month; and I invite the Governors of the several States and the Territories and possessions of the United States to issue similar proclamations","parent_excerpt":"do hereby set apart the month of April 1948 as Cancer Control Month; and I invite the Governors of the several States and the Territories and possessions of the United States to issue similar proclamations","explanation":"The core operative provision is identical except for the annual date."},{"child_excerpt":"I also invite the medical profession, the press, the radio, the motion-picture industry, and all organizations and individuals interested in a national program for the control of cancer by education and other cooperative means to unite during the month of April","parent_excerpt":"I also invite the medical profession, the press, the radio, the motion-picture industry, and all organizations and individuals interested in a national program for the control of cancer by education and other cooperative means to unite during the month of April","explanation":"The child repeats a long, distinctive enumeration and mobilization clause verbatim, then modestly revises its concluding purpose."}]}
